svg.title: Which MCP servers a Claude Code permission rule reaches, before and from version 2.1.299
svg.desc: From the Claude Code 2.1.299 changelog dated October 14, 2026. An allow rule mcp__a reached the servers a, a__b, and a_ before 2.1.299. From 2.1.299 it reaches only the server a. A deny or ask rule mcp__a__b for a server whose normalized name contains a double underscore did not apply before 2.1.299 and applies from 2.1.299.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: Which MCP servers does the rule reach?
